claim.summary: the port performed the same ROM function-pointer dispatches as the console — same sites, same order, same RESOLVED GAMECUBE TARGETS, same frame arguments — on 40 recorded cases
verifies: the resolved GameCube target of 40 dispatch(es), against the address the console's own branch register held at the branch
0 argument slot(s), allocated per the PowerPC EABI from the value classes the port itself declared
no dispatch return value (every observed dispatch was BRIDGED, and a bridged return is supplied by the harness, never verified)
no watch-window bytes across a dispatch (every observed dispatch was bridged, and a bridged callee's side effects are REPLAYED into the arena, never checked)
the interleaving of dispatches with the function's direct out-of-unit calls
NOTHING about memory: all 49876 owned-region bytes compared at return were byte-identical to what the harness SEEDED, so the comparison read back its own input
the emitted dispatch table: all 8 entries agree with oracle-registry.json on which function lives at each GC address
does_not_verify: any memory write set — this standard is ORTHOGONAL to oracle_green and never totals with it
the CONTENTS of the ROM's function-pointer table: the capture seeds them from the live console. What is verified is which entry the port selects
a BRIDGED dispatch's return value, which this harness supplies from the console's r3 word
the watch window across 1348 byte(s) of in-table dispatch: those dispatches serviced nested calls from this harness, so their bytes were REPLAYED rather than compared
a bridged callee's non-i32 return width, which the bridge does not reproduce
the behaviour of any dispatched callee; 2 call(s) made from inside an in-table target were serviced without comparison
the arity of a call site, which comes from the decompiled C — the port's own substrate
site identity beyond the enclosing function, for any function with more than one indirect call (Ghidra's structured C need not order sites as the machine code does)
any input outside the recorded corpus
claim.not_a_ladder: dispatch_green observes a channel the other standards cannot see and is blind to channels they check. It is never an upgrade of, and never totals with, any of them.

wrong_thunk_defence.why: a transcript taken at the thunk is self-consistent with a WRONG address-to-thunk mapping. These three checks are each grounded outside the companion: the console's own branch register, the DOL-derived oracle registry, and the emitted table itself.

source.control_strategy: breakpoint the function entry, every out-of-unit call site AND every indirect branch in its in-unit closure, the instruction after each, and the entry LR; read CTR (bctrl) or LR (blrl) at the branch, before it executes, to record the RESOLVED TARGET; terminate the case at the return with a stack-pointer guard
source.emulator: bundled Dolphin 2606-97 (dolphin/Dolphin.exe), Null video, CPU only
source.game_state: 2v2 sav reloaded with a pl0900 roster in slots [0, 1, 2, 3] (roster depth 6) + B/X/A press-release edges
exclusions: dispatch_green is ORTHOGONAL to oracle_green and STRICTLY WEAKER than it: no memory write set is compared

the ROM's function-pointer TABLES are seeded from the live console (see seeded_dispatch_tables) -- bytes the port is GIVEN. What the port must derive on its own is WHICH ENTRY it selects, which is the behaviour under test
a dispatched callee's own behaviour is NOT verified: an in-window target runs the port's own code, an out-of-window target is a stub replaying the console's return registers
a bridged (out-of-window) return is supplied to the port as the console's r3 word only; a non-i32 return width crossing the bridge is NOT reproduced

argument registers are recorded RAW (r3-r10, f1-f8). The EABI slot each frame argument occupies is allocated at replay time from the CLASSES THE PORT ITSELF DECLARES, so a wrong class reads a wrong register and goes red

site binding is EXACT only for a function with exactly one indirect call; with two or more the comparison names the function, because Ghidra's structured C need not order sites as the machine code does
console stack addresses are excluded (the wasm module has its own linear stack)
the claim is bounded by this corpus -- N recorded cases, never all inputs

table_audit.why: the companion derives a thunk's GC address from the window's own sources; the registry derives it from the DOL. A disagreement means the table routes an address to the wrong function, which a thunk-side transcript would record faithfully.
